issue_reason: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda (he/she/it) fe'l 'has' shaklida bo'ladi. O'zbek tilida shaxs bo'yicha fe'l oxirida qo'shimcha o'zgargani bilan, ingliz tilidagi 'have/has' mutlaq farqlanishi ko'pincha e'tibordan chetda qoladi.
example_wrong: She have many questions.

issue_reason: 'Discuss' fe'li bevosita to'ldiruvchi oladi va o'timli hisoblanadi. O'zbek tilidagi 'haqida gaplashmoq/muhokama qilmoq' modelining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'chirilishi natijasida 'about' ortiqcha qo'shilgan.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'discuss the issue' deb yozing ('about' so'zini olib tashlang).
example_wrong: We discussed about the lesson plan.

issue_reason: 'Explain' fe'li shaxsga qaratilganda 'to' predlogi bilan kelishi shart. O'zbek tilidagi 'menga tushuntir' iborasi ingliz tilida 'explain to me' shaklida ifodalanadi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'explain to me' yoki 'explain this to me'.
example_wrong: The teacher explained me the rule.
example_right: The teacher explained the rule to me.

issue_reason: 'Agree' ingliz tilida sifat emas, mustaqil fe'ldir. O'zbek tilidagi 'men roziman' (sifat-kesim) konstruksiyasi ta'sirida talabalar ko'pincha 'am/is/are' bog'lovchisini xato qo'shib yuborishadi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'I agree' / 'I don't agree' deb yozing.
example_wrong: I am agree with this method.

issue_reason: 'Better/easier' kabi so'zlar allaqachon qiyosiy shakl. Unga 'more' qo'shish grammatik ortiqchalik (pleonazm) hisoblanadi — o'zbekcha 'yanada yaxshiroq' modelining ta'siri.
example_wrong: This method is more better.

issue_reason: 'Criteria', 'phenomena', 'children' so'zlarining o'zi ko'plik shakli. O'zbek tilidagi muntazam '-lar' qo'shimchasiga o'xshatib inglizcha '-s' qo'shish xatodir.
example_wrong: These criterias are important.

issue_short: Ortiqcha takroriy ifoda ('in my opinion I think')
issue_reason: 'In my opinion' va 'I think' ayni bir ma'noni ifodalaydi. Ikkalasini yonma-yon ishlatish akademik yozuvda nojo'ya takror hisoblanadi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: yo 'In my opinion, ...' yoki 'I think that ...'.
example_wrong: In my opinion I think rubrics help.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilidagi '...dan bog'liq' qo'shimchasi ingliz tiliga 'from' shaklida noto'g'ri ko'chirilgan (L1 ta'siri). To'g'ri bog'lanish: 'depend on'.
example_wrong: Success depends from motivation.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilidagi '... bilan tabriklamoq' sintaktik modeli ta'sirida 'with' ishlatilgan. Ingliz tilida esa 'congratulate (someone) on' bo'ladi.
example_wrong: I congratulated him with the award.
example_right: I congratulated him on the award.

issue_reason: 'Enter' va 'reach' fe'llari o'timli bo'lib, o'zbek tilidagi '...ga kirmoq/yetmoq' tushunchasidagi yo'nalish qo'shimchasi inglizchaga 'to' qilib ortiqcha qo'shilgan.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'to' predlogisiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri obyektni yozing (masalan: 'enter the classroom').
example_wrong: Students entered to the classroom.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilidagi '...da yaxshi/usta' ma'nosi ingliz tilida 'good in' emas, 'good at' orqali ifodalanadi.
example_wrong: She is good in teaching.

issue_reason: O'zbekcha '... bilan turmush qurgan' modeli ko'chirilgan. Ingliz tilida 'married to (someone)' ishlatiladi.
example_wrong: He is married with a teacher.
example_right: He is married to a teacher.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilida 'musiqa tinglamoq' to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi oladi, ingliz tilida esa 'listen' fe'li doimo 'to' bilan keladi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'listen to the audio / listen to music'.
example_wrong: Students listen the audio twice.
example_right: Students listen to the audio twice.

issue_reason: '... haqida qiziqmoq' modelining ko'chirilishi. Ingliz tilida 'interested in' qo'llanadi.
example_wrong: I am interested about methodology.

issue_reason: 'According to' faqat uchinchi manbaga ishora qiladi ('according to Vygotsky'). O'z fikrini bildirish uchun 'in my opinion' yoki 'I think' ishlatiladi ('menimcha' ning kalka tarjimasi).
example_wrong: According to me, feedback is vital.
example_right: In my opinion, feedback is vital.

issue_reason: O'zbek/rus tillarida yosh 'ega' orqali ifodalanadi, ingliz tilida esa 'to be ... years old' qo'llanadi.
example_wrong: I have 20 years.

issue_reason: O'zbekcha 'rasm qilmoq/olmoq' ta'sirida 'make' ishlatilgan. Ingliz tilida 'take a photo/picture' kollokatsiyasi qo'llanadi.
example_wrong: We made photos of the lesson.
example_right: We took photos of the lesson.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilida 'o'rgatmoq' va 'o'rganmoq' bir o'zakdan, ingliz tilida esa 'teach' (o'rgatmoq) va 'learn' (o'rganmoq) alohida fe'llar.
example_wrong: The mentor learned us new techniques.
example_right: The mentor taught us new techniques.

issue_reason: 'Say' fe'li shaxs to'ldiruvchisini bevosita olmaydi: 'say to me' yoki 'tell me'. O'zbekcha 'menga aytdi' modeli to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'chirilgan.
example_wrong: The teacher said me to repeat.
example_right: The teacher told me to repeat.

issue_reason: O'zbekcha 'har kunlar' (ko'plik) modeli ta'siri. Ingliz tilida 'every' doimo birlik ot bilan keladi.
example_wrong: We practise every days.

issue_reason: 'One of' dan keyin doimo ko'plik ot keladi ('do'stlarimdan biri'). O'zbekcha tarjimada birlik qoladi, ingliz tilida esa '-s' majburiy.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'one of my friends', 'one of the reasons'.
example_wrong: One of the reason is anxiety.
example_right: One of the reasons is anxiety.

issue_reason: 'Can' va 'be able to' bir xil ma'noni beradi; ikkisi birga ishlatilmaydi.
example_wrong: Students can able to write essays.

issue_short: 'didn't went' — yordamchi fe'ldan keyin o'tgan zamon
issue_reason: 'Did/does/do' yordamchi fe'li zamonni o'zida ko'rsatadi; asosiy fe'l infinitiv (asos) shaklida qoladi. O'zbek tilida kesim o'zi zamon qo'shimchasi olgani uchun bu qoida tez-tez buziladi.
example_wrong: She didn't went to the seminar.
example_right: She didn't go to the seminar.

issue_reason: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda inkor 'doesn't' bo'ladi. O'zbek tilida inkor qo'shimchasi shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi, shu sababli 'don't' umumlashtirib yuboriladi.
example_wrong: The teacher don't use rubrics.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilida 'agar kelsam' kelasi zamonda ifodalanadi, ingliz tilida esa 'if/when' dan keyin hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi (Conditional I).
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'If I have time, I will ...'.
example_wrong: If students will practise, they improve.
example_right: If students practise, they will improve.

issue_reason: 'Since' boshlanish nuqtasini (since 2020), 'for' esa davomiylikni (for 5 years) bildiradi. O'zbekcha '5 yildan beri' ikkalasiga ham tarjima qilinishi mumkinligi chalkashlik tug'diradi.
example_wrong: I have taught since 5 years.

issue_reason: O'zbekcha '2 yil oldin' so'zma-so'z 'before 2 years' deb tarjima qilinadi; ingliz tilida vaqt miqdoridan keyin 'ago' keladi.
example_wrong: I graduated before 2 years.

issue_reason: 'Emphasize', 'mention', 'stress' fe'llari o'timli: predlogsiz to'ldiruvchi oladi. O'zbekcha '...ga urg'u bermoq / ... haqida eslatmoq' modeli ta'siri.
example_wrong: The author emphasizes on feedback.

issue_reason: 'Answer' fe'l sifatida predlogsiz ishlatiladi ('answer the question'); 'to' faqat ot bilan keladi ('an answer to the question'). O'zbekcha 'savolga javob bermoq' modeli ta'siri.
example_wrong: Students answered to the questions.

issue_short: 'the most easiest' ikki karra orttirma daraja
issue_reason: '-est' qo'shimchasi allaqachon orttirma daraja; 'most' bilan birga ishlatilmaydi ('eng eng' kabi).
example_wrong: This is the most easiest task.

issue_reason: O'zbek tilida barcha fe'llar bir xil '-di' qo'shimchasini oladi, shu sababli inglizcha noto'g'ri fe'llar (taught, wrote, thought) muntazam '-ed' bilan yasalib ketadi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: taught / wrote / thought / bought / went.
example_wrong: She teached grammar last year.

issue_reason: 'Information, advice, homework, feedback, knowledge' sanalmas otlar — ko'plik shakli yo'q. O'zbek tilida bular bemalol ko'plikda ishlatilgani uchun L1 ta'siri yuzaga keladi.
example_wrong: Teachers gave useful advices.

issue_reason: O'zbekcha 'internetda / televizorda' o'rin-payt kelishigi 'in' deb tarjima qilinadi, lekin ingliz tilida ommaviy axborot vositalari bilan 'on' qo'llanadi.
example_wrong: I found this article in the internet.
example_right: I found this article on the internet.

issue_reason: Ingliz tilida hafta kunlari va sanalar bilan 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi; o'zbekcha 'dushanbada' modeli 'at/in' ga noto'g'ri o'giriladi.
example_wrong: The seminar is at Monday.

issue_reason: 'Home' ravish sifatida predlogsiz ishlatiladi ('go home'). O'zbekcha 'uyga bormoq' jo'nalish kelishigi 'to' ga aylanib ketadi.
example_wrong: After the lesson I went to home.
example_right: After the lesson I went home.

issue_reason: Ingliz tilida 'make a mistake' kollokatsiyasi qo'llanadi; o'zbekcha 'xato qilmoq' ('qilmoq' = do) ta'sirida 'do' tanlanadi.
example_wrong: Learners do many mistakes in articles.
example_right: Learners make many mistakes in articles.

issue_reason: 'Homework, exercise, research' bilan 'do' fe'li keladi. O'zbekcha 'uy vazifasini bajarmoq/qilmoq' har ikki fe'lga tarjima qilinishi chalkashlik beradi.
example_wrong: Students make their homework at night.
example_right: Students do their homework at night.

issue_reason: 'Suggest' dan keyin shaxs + infinitiv kelmaydi: 'suggest that we ...' yoki 'suggest doing'. O'zbekcha 'menga ... ni taklif qildi' modeli ta'siri.
example_wrong: She suggested me to use rubrics.
example_right: She suggested that I use rubrics.

issue_reason: '-ing' sifati sababni (boring lesson), '-ed' sifati his-tuyg'uni (bored student) bildiradi. O'zbek tilida bunday farq yo'qligi uchun 'zerikdim' → 'I am boring' deb o'giriladi.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'I am bored' / 'The lesson was boring'.
example_wrong: Students were boring during the lecture.
example_right: Students were bored during the lecture.

issue_reason: O'zbek/ruscha 'aktual' (dolzarb) inglizcha 'actual' (haqiqiy, real) bilan bir xil emas. Bu 'false friend' xatosi.
example_wrong: This is an actual problem in ELT.
example_right: This is a pressing problem in ELT.

issue_reason: 'Konspekt, leksiya, praktika, nazorat ishi, referat' kabi atamalar inglizcha o'xshash so'zga emas, boshqa atamaga tarjima qilinadi: notes, lecture, practice, test, essay/report, thesis, master's degree, applicant.
example_wrong: I wrote a conspect of the lection.
example_right: I took notes during the lecture.

issue_short: Sanalmas ot bilan noaniq artikl ('an information')
issue_reason: O'zbek tilida artikl yo'q; sanalmas otlar ('information, advice, feedback') bilan 'a/an' ishlatilmaydi — 'some', 'a piece of' qo'llanadi.
example_wrong: He gave me an advice.

issue_reason: Ingliz tilida 'very' fe'lni bevosita kuchaytirmaydi: 'I like it very much' yoki 'I really like it'. O'zbekcha 'juda yoqtiraman' (ravish fe'l oldida) modeli ta'siri.
suggestion: Tuzatish: 'I really like ...' / 'I like ... very much'.
example_wrong: Students very like the game.

issue_short: Holat fe'li 'to be' bilan ('I am understand')
issue_reason: 'Understand, know, want' holat fe'llari oddiy zamonda ishlatiladi; ularning oldiga 'am/is/are' qo'yilmaydi. O'zbekcha '-man/-san' shaxs qo'shimchasi 'am/are' deb o'giriladi.
example_wrong: I am not understand the task.
